thought.text: Let me get the real entry URL from the rendered page and from the vite_ruby manifest.

reasoning_content:
There was an issue with the quote handling in my rails runner. Let me write it as a small script and run it. Actually there's an easier way: render the app layout and grab the desktop.ts script tag. The SPA at `/` loads `form.js` and `application.js` (legacy rails assets). The desktop app entry is loaded via `vite_typescript_tag 'desktop'`, which in dev mode is served via the vite_ruby proxy through Rails at something like `/assets/frontend/vite-dev/desktop.ts`. But that returned 404… Actually wait — vite_ruby's dev proxy serves entries at `/assets/frontend/<entry>.ts`. Hmm, but that 404 page was actually a vite-ruby error page.

Actually, let me check vite.config.mjs more carefully — there may be an entrypoint prefix. Let me look at the vite_ruby manifest and how entries are resolved. Let me try rendering the actual app view with the logged-in session: `GET /` with session cookie renders init#index (the SPA shell), which includes the vite tag. Let me fetch the full HTML of / with the cookie and grep for "desktop.ts" or vite script tags.

action.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -c '
echo "=== / full HTML: vite script tags ==="
curl -s -b /tmp/cj3.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | grep -oE "<script[^>]*src=\"[^\"]*\"[^>]*>" | head -10
echo "=== /assets/frontend/ listing via proxy ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "vite-dev root: HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000/assets/frontend/
' 2>&1
